access_method: Overpass QL spatial strip & bounding box queries with automated mirror failover

coverage_bounds.region: Chennai Metropolitan Area, Tamil Nadu, India

derived_metrics.total_road_length_km: Sum of road polyline lengths in projected UTM 44N meters
derived_metrics.road_density_km_per_km2: Total road length in km divided by grid cell area in km2
derived_metrics.mapped_building_count: Count of mapped building ways inside grid cell
derived_metrics.building_density_per_km2: Mapped building count divided by grid cell area in km2
derived_metrics.mapped_building_area_km2: Estimated total building footprint area in km2 based on empirical sample
derived_metrics.building_coverage_percent: Percentage of grid cell area covered by mapped building footprints
derived_metrics.poi_counts: Categorized count of mapped amenities and transit hubs

known_limitations: Volunteered geographic information: mapping density varies by urban center vs periphery.
Absence of a mapped feature does not imply non-existence.
Building counts reflect mapped physical structures and must NOT be used as population counts.
Features reflect OSM database state as of the access timestamp.
